ideas.title: Following the Money in the Feeding Our Future Investigation
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trail of the Feeding Our Future scheme, including how the money was laundered and who was involved.
questions: Who was involved in the scheme?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the inner workings of the Feeding Our Future scheme. By following the money, we may be able to identify other individuals or organizations involved in the scheme.
